text: {"lessons":["My account fell overall despite brief rebounds, so I should judge progress over time rather than let a single month's return sway me.","Making no trades avoids impulsive decisions, but it is not automatically prudent; I should periodically review risk and whether my holdings still suit my goals.","Because price changes are random, I should base any trade on my plan and current assessment, not on recent price moves or a wish to avoid admitting a mistake."]}
